title: Does Not hold 2 pieces of salmon, very small, no lid to steam with!
text:
Does Not hold 2 pieces of salmon, very small, no lid to steam with!. This is a different idea to steam a small amount
Of food!

You have to put this steamer top over a pan with water to get the steam
To your food.
I understand, I use a regular double steamer everyday for veggies.
I thought this would be good to steam salmon on.
My problem with this is, it does not hold a decent size piece of fresh
Alaskan salmon for 2 people, and this needs a lid to steam Properly.
My husband and I are small eaters, but the kiddos are not.

Btw, I have a big family, this is basically useless for me, but can be
A good choice for a single person.

Also my Handle sticks flat straight out, and I notice that it’s suppose to
Be in a up position, and my handle is also loose!

I’m not a fan.
I’m giving 3 stars in case this can do better!!
